title: Integer multiplicity truncations T⌞{φ>λ_k} with finite mass and boundary mass (Simon 6.2, second paragraph)
lean_statement: SlicingTheorem → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W < ∞ ∧ T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), (∀ k, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X k)) ∧ (∀ k, (X k).mass + (X k).boundary.mass < ∞) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), ∀ᶠ k in atTop, X k (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) (m + 1) ω) = T ω
